docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A university-level textbook of human physiology: the cell, the nervous, muscular, endocrine, cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, urinary and reproductive systems, immunity and the senses.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Human Physiology, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
